workflows.name: Cold brew
workflows.title: Grow organic search traffic
workflows.summary: Grow organic traffic on a site you own: crawl it for technical problems, give each query one page that wins it, then tighten the copy.
workflows.note: seo-polish and keyword-resolver package parts of this route.

pairsWith.name: OpenSEO
pairsWith.for: keyword volumes, rankings, backlinks, competitor and AI-visibility data, read by your agent through its MCP server.
pairsWith.needs: Open source (MIT); needs a DataForSEO API key (pay per use) or an openseo.so account.

workflows.name: French press
workflows.title: Land a job
workflows.summary: Run a job search without inventing credentials: see your resume the way recruiters screen it, write the tailored version, then manage the applications.
workflows.note: It never submits an application for you.

workflows.name: Cupping
workflows.title: Make a decision
workflows.summary: Turn a hard question into a decision you can defend: gather sourced evidence, read your own numbers, attack the options, then write the memo.

workflows.name: Slow drip
workflows.title: Learn a skill
workflows.summary: Learn any topic from zero: get taught concept by concept, then build the practice system that makes it stick.
workflows.note: course-builder applies when the learner is a class or cohort, not one person.

workflows.name: Nitro
workflows.title: Run cold outbound
workflows.summary: Send cold email that lands: check the lead list before it loads, size and protect the sending setup, then write the copy.

workflows.name: Moka pot
workflows.title: Launch a one-person product
workflows.summary: Take a one-person product from plan to launch: pick the offer, build the site and code, write the policy pages, pass the release gate, then announce it.
workflows.note: Step five is the whole of Brew 3 · Espresso; paper-trail gives the gate the policy pages to check.

workflows.name: Descale
workflows.title: Maintain the skill family
workflows.summary: Keep a family of skills healthy after release: tune what drifted, re-release what changed, and confirm every listing still matches.
workflows.note: The nightly health job opens the issue this starts from; a weekly scheduled session runs it and opens PRs.

workflows.name: Estate roast
workflows.title: Stand up or audit a skill estate
workflows.summary: Inventory and repair a whole collection of skills in one gated run, from repos and listings to the workflows that connect them.
workflows.note: One run over the whole collection in eight gated phases; Brew 10 · Descale keeps it healthy afterwards.
